questions.question: At a continuing-task time-limit cutoff, what should happen to the value bootstrap and the reverse GAE trace?
options: Zero both because the environment reset
Bootstrap from the final pre-reset observation, then stop the trace
Bootstrap from the reset observation and continue the trace
Continue the trace but suppress the bootstrap
questions.explanation: A collector cutoff does not end the continuing task, so its final pre-reset state supplies the value bootstrap. The trace stops at the cutoff to prevent advantages from a later reset episode from crossing the boundary.
optionFeedback: The cutoff ends collection, not the underlying continuing process; it keeps its final-state bootstrap but breaks the trace.

A collector cutoff does not end the continuing task, so its final pre-reset state supplies the value bootstrap. The trace stops at the cutoff to prevent advantages from a later reset episode from crossing the boundary.
The reset observation belongs to the new episode and must not replace the retained transition result.
The trace must stop at the boundary, while the value bootstrap remains enabled for a continuing task.
